native_semantic_adaptations: Use exact executed feature states and independent seeded binomial counts at 2048 trials per entry in place of hosted overlap sampling. Keep both data workflows, the feature maps, support-vector restriction, and the original classical SVC. Scientific packages are installed locally for this example.
